interpretation: Aggressive buying/CVD has increased materially while open interest has declined, yet price has not advanced proportionally. This is buyer inefficiency / passive-seller absorption rather than a clean bullish continuation signal. OI down means the move is not being driven by fresh leveraged longs and may include short covering/deleveraging. Price remains above the current dPOC, so lower structure is not yet broken.

trade_logic.preferred_trigger: Hold/retest dPOC near 76860, then reclaim and accept above roughly 77150-77200 with CVD staying firm; do not buy solely because CVD is high.
trade_logic.bearish_invalidation: Loss of dPOC followed by acceptance below dVAL/dOpen, especially if price and CVD fall while OI turns up, restores bearish leverage-expansion risk.
trade_logic.lesson: Flow effort without price result is information: rising CVD with falling OI but stagnant/lower price can reveal passive supply. Require price response before entry.
